# Fixture for PERF-PY-26 (safe): lightweight HTTP field latin-1 codec in a
# header/trailer loop is not an expensive blob decode (niquests WASI adapter).
lang: python
file: extensions/wasi/_utils.py
---
def decode_field_value(value: bytes | bytearray) -> str:
    data = value if isinstance(value, bytes) else bytes(value)
    try:
        return data.decode("latin-1")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return data.decode("utf-8")


def response_headers(entries):
    headers = {}
    for name, value in entries:
        headers[name] = decode_field_value(value)
    return headers
